queue.title: Add --mock-network to other prehook runner tests
queue.description: Apply the same --mock-network pattern from e-prehook-runner (wq-1032) to a/r/b-prehook-runner tests if they make real network calls. Check each runner for async network deps and add flag+wrapper pattern.

outcome.note: Audited all 3 runners: a-prehook has only localhost curl (try/catch wrapped), r-prehook same, b-prehook has zero network calls. All tests pass fast (a:3s, r:1.2s, b:2.6s) without mocking. --mock-network only needed for e-prehook's external async APIs (chatr, colony-jwt, recovery-probe).

queue.title: Add resurrect pass audit metric to audit-stats.mjs
queue.description: (added ~s2088): Track cumulative platform resurrections from DNS prune resurrect pass. Read services.json for platforms recovered from defunct status, report count in audit stats to gauge whether 200-session resurrect interval is appropriate.

queue.title: Mock grepFileCount in revalidate tests
queue.description: (added ~s2090): knowledge-revalidate.test.mjs validatePattern tests currently shell out to real grep (each test ~500ms). Injecting a mock grepFileCount would make tests deterministic and ~100x faster. Would also enable testing edge cases like "exactly 2 specific matches" without depending on codebase state.

outcome.note: Added { grepFn } option to validatePattern(), created mockGrep() helper in tests. 7 validatePattern tests now use mocks — deterministic, ~0.2ms each vs ~500ms. Added edge case tests (exactly 2 specific, single-file-2-hits). All 35 tests pass.
